messages:
Avery (Product): Quick note from the usability session: users keep thinking the Private setup wizard is hung during the Network checks step when multiple probes are pending. They stare at the three rows of 'waiting' dots and wait.
Mark (PM): Can you paste the exact screen? I want to see spacing and copy.
Avery (Product): Screenshot: https://redwood/mock/network-checks. The issue is visual density + repeated 'waiting' states. They also missed the small help link at the bottom.
Jun (Design): Observed same. My idea: compress the active probes into a single summary line while probes are running, e.g. "3 network checks running 3s" with a chevron to expand details. This reduces clutter and reduces perceived stuckness.
Priya (Eng): Backend emits probe events constantly (every 2s) which drives the UI updates. We can add a coalesced summary event to reduce chatter. Also we can tag final events for clean animations.
Sam (Frontend): From frontend POV: implement a collapsed row that shows summary text, an elapsed timer, and a "View details" toggle. On expand show each probe with status, timestamp, and a small KB link. We'll need an endpoint for per-probe troubleshooting keys.
Avery (Product): Copy change requests: replace "Attempting SSH" with "Checking SSH access" and replace terse errors like "Timed out" with friendlier text like "No response from host". Also add a one-line preface: "These checks may take up to 30s depending on network."
Jun (Design): Also the microcopy under each probe currently truncates badly on narrow widths. Let's allow wrapping and avoid ellipses for the brief explanation. And bump timestamp contrast to at least 60% gray.
AccessibilityBot: Note: screen readers are being verbose because each probe update triggers an announcement. Recommend a single summary aria-live region with polite updates; throttle to one update per second and provide per-probe details only when user expands.
Priya (Eng): We can add a `probe_summary` event every 3s and `probe_complete` immediately on finish. I'll include an optional `kb_id` field like `SSH_EGRESS_BLOCKED`.
Sam (Frontend): Interaction detail: when a probe finishes, animate spinner -> status icon (check/x) with a quick 200-300ms crossfade to signal progress. Avoid layout shifts by reserving icon space.
Avery (Product): Also request: add a tiny "What does this mean?" link per probe that opens the KB to the matching `kb_id`. Makes troubleshooting less mysterious.
Mark (PM): Action items: Jun to update copy + contrast and produce revised mock; Sam to prototype collapsed summary + expand details; Priya to add `probe_summary` events and `kb_id`; AccessibilityBot recommendations to be implemented; Avery to update KB anchors. Target: end of next week.
Priya (Eng): I'll open a branch `summary-probes-ui` and add schema changes. Pinging CI.
CI-Bot: CI queued for branch `summary-probes-ui`  build #789 started.
Sam (Frontend): I'll drop the Figma link here by Friday EOD.
Jun (Design): I'll attach copy variants and contrast samples. Feeling good about this pattern reducing cognitive load.
Avery (Product): Thanks everyone. If this reduces false 'stuck' support tickets it's a big win.
Mark (PM): Agreed. Small UX polish with measurable impact. :thumbsup:
